verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes JMAP through its own session endpoint. JMAP lets a client POST a methodCalls array that combines query, fetch and send in one HTTP request, which gives programmatic batching that an AI-native client could use for multi-item work. The evidence does not show bulk mutation of many items (mass move, label, delete or archive), and the UI-side bulk features appear only as bare article titles. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk set/update across many messages, documented limits on batch size, UI bulk-select evidence, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
